title: Why F1 Pit Stops Got So Incredibly Fast
hook: A pit stop used to take a minute.
closing: Blink. You'll miss the whole pit stop.
question: Did you know pit stops got this fast?

segments.say: In the 1950s, an F1 pit stop took about a minute. By 2023, McLaren did it in 1.8 seconds.
An average human reaction time is about 0.27 seconds -- the whole modern pit stop takes under seven of those.
It takes roughly twenty crew members now to do what a handful managed back in the 1950s.
